result.summary: The page is largely well laid out, but the promotional banner has a clear visual defect: its headline and subtext are rendered in near-white on a pale mint background, making the offer text almost unreadable. No other broken elements were found; carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white/very light on a light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast. The offer and promo code are nearly illegible, which looks like a styling bug (light text intended for a dark/saturated background).
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., the app's dark green or near-black) on the pale banner, or darken/saturate the banner background so the white text meets at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).
